verdict.rationale: VPM's first-party docs say it acts as registered agent, receiving service of process, legal notices and state correspondence. They also say this is "Included FREE with all virtual mailbox plans" and that served documents are scanned online the same day, so it is bundled with the mailbox plan. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of state coverage and of how the service is managed within the account.
